\begin{linenotes}
\item[1] \texttt{numpy} is a library for lists of numbers. \texttt{np} is its short name.
\item[2] \texttt{np.argsort(leiden)} lists the node numbers sorted by group, so that nodes of one group sit together.
\item[3] \texttt{layout\_circle(order=order)} puts the nodes on a circle in that order, so that each group takes one arc. The layout is a position for every node.
\item[4] A fresh empty panel.
\item[5] The drawing call again, with \texttt{layout=layout} to use our positions instead of igraph's own.
\item[6] Show the picture.
